text:
The panel unanimously agrees that the scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, supported by evidence E6. Trains will run every 6 minutes at peak, supported by evidence E5.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; trains every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists agree that dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres and that the terminal's annual capacity after the expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: The berth pocket will be deepened to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity will be 2.1 million TEU after the expansion.

The three-phase expansion programme lays new pipe as follows: Phase 1 – 12.4 km, Phase 2 – 8.7 km, and Phase 3 – 15.6 km. Summing these gives a total of 36.7 km.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres.

The tunnel's original opening date was 14 September 2026. An announced delay of 11 weeks (77 days) pushes the opening back. Adding 77 days to 14 September 2026 gives 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

The panel consistently reported that mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg, and 19 participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists reached consensus that FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and diarrhoea was the most common adverse event, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and the most common adverse event was diarrhoea (22% of olvemarin participants).

The panelists consistently calculated that 54 out of 450 participants in the senotrazide arm discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding (54 ÷ 450) × 100 = 12%.

Answer: 12%

All panelists agree: 312 participants were randomized to pelvastrin (E2). Non-completers were 27 who withdrew consent (E3), 14 lost to follow-up (E4), and 19 who died (E5), totaling 60. Subtracting gives 312 − 60 = 252.

Answer: 252 participants in the pelvastrin arm completed the 24-month follow-up.

All panelists unanimously agree that Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million (E5) and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8% (E6). A single outlier figure of $438 million was identified as inconsistent with the cited evidence.

Answer: Corvane Logistics' order backlog at year end was $386 million, and it guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

The panel reached strong consensus that Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%. Five of six panelists confirmed the CET1 figure; the net interest margin was unanimous.

Answer: CET1 ratio: 14.3%; Net interest margin: 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. The growth percentage is calculated as ($45 / $250) × 100 = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million, yielding free cash flow of $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million.

The panelists unanimously concluded, based on evidence E4 and E5, that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

The panel unanimously agreed, citing facts E4 and E7, that the contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros. One outlier suggested 9.5 million euros for the cap, but this was rejected as unsupported.

Answer: The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

The panel's reasoning supports that the effective date is 18 February 2025, and payment must be made within 45 calendar days, counting 19 February as day 1. Counting: February 19–28 gives 10 days, March gives 31 days (total 41), and April 1–4 gives the remaining 4 days, reaching day 45 on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025.

The panel unanimously concludes the total is $2.88 million, comprising $2.35 million in compensatory damages, $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable court costs. The 20% contributory negligence reduction is already reflected in the damages, and legal fees are not recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million.

The panel reached strong consensus that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and was found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the sediment core.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists agree that LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm and that test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a period of 16 years. Dividing the total retreat by the time span gives 384 ÷ 16 = 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year.

The number of breeding pairs declined from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a drop of 370 pairs. The percentage decline is (370 / 1,480) × 100 = 25%.

Answer: 25%

All five panelists unanimously agree on both figures. The records of 48,600 patients were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025 using a stolen contractor password.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

The panel's reasoning consistently supports that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight. One panelist mentioned 270 kg, but this was identified as an outlier and likely a misinterpretation of the evidence.

Answer: Approximately 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage began at 22:47 UTC on 9 October and ended at 03:12 UTC on 10 October. The duration from 22:47 to 03:12 is 4 hours and 25 minutes.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

All panelists agree: the incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, totaling 42,000 attempts. Applying the 30% failure rate yields 12,600 failed attempts.

Answer: 12,600
